  • People Occlusion rendering pipeline — ARKit segments people in the camera feed and composites virtual content behind them so real people appear in front of virtual objects. Controls whether buyers see believable mixed-reality occlusion. Does not generate Chinese listing text. AppLocale does not implement this.
